column24: PRIDE PXD005077 and author F1000Research supplement Additional file 1 link SCi502-510 to seven clinical animals; supplemental notes identify SCi511 as pooled ill-serum and SCi512 as pooled healthy control (20 sheep). Clinical signs are not promoted to specific diagnoses. TripleTOF 5600+ SWATH acquisition is described in the article.
